pose: A highly detailed, close-up shot of a well-lit paleontological preparation laboratory bench, showcasing a large fossilized dinosaur limb bone partially embedded in a multi-textured geological block. The block acts as a visual matrix matrix, cleanly displaying distinct rock textures and colors from left to right. On one side, it features dark, crumbly, charcoal-like segments of carbonaceous lignite blending into fine-grained, smooth, grey-brown mudstone and fissile, layered grey shale. The center section transitions into grainy, buff-colored sandstone next to a coarse, pebbled conglomerate filled with rounded river stones. The remaining side shows dense, blocky cream limestone, a highly porous, light-grey layer of volcanic tuff, a chunk of brittle, powdery red-orange claystone, uniform tan siltstone, and a hard, heavy nodule of dark reddish-brown ironstone. A paleontology preparator's hand is visible in the corner using a fine pneumatic air scribe, clearing away dust to expose the dark, petrified bone surface, with bright task lighting catching the contrasting mineral grains, matrix colors, and rocky textures for clear gameplay comparison.
